prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full address for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the street and city, if that's okay. It's a residential street in Sugar Land.

Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened when the collision occurred?

A: I was turning left at a signal-controlled intersection. The light had turned green for me, and I started into the turn. A vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Were you able to see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I remember seeing headlights as I was in the middle of the turn, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I hit my head on the side window. I felt dizzy and my head was pounding. I didn't think it was serious at first, but later I had nausea and trouble focusing on the screen at work.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?

A: Yes, I was evaluated at an urgent care clinic and then followed up with my primary care physician. They told me I have a concussion and I've been advised to limit screen time and rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Some of them. The headaches are less frequent, but bright light still bothers me and I get tired quickly.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the collision?

A: Only that I want to make sure my statement is accurate. I was driving carefully and I was following the signal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the recorded statement.
